description: Create a new appointment in the CRM. Supports slot validation overrides.

access_token.description: CRM access token (optional — your connected CRM is used when omitted)

appointmentStatus.description: Status (e.g. confirmed, cancelled, showed, noshow, invalid)

assignedUserId.description: User ID to assign the appointment to

body.description: Request body fields for endpoints whose definition declares none (explicit fields win)

calendarId.description: Calendar ID to book the appointment in

location_id.description: CRM sub-account location ID (optional — defaults to your connected location)

name: crm_create_appointment
